snippet.text:
structure Issues (N p) : Prop where
  initial : ∃ F, Curve (a.budget N) (n:=a.S.side N p) F (band a N) ∧
      ∀ β∈band a N,(F β).beta=β ∧ Lives R N N p (F β) ∧ R.Starter N p (F β)
  advances (m : ℕ) : m < N →
    ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → ∀ Q, Curve (a.budget (m+1)) Q (Icc l u) →
      (∀ x∈ Icc l u, Lives R N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band a (m+1)) →
      ∃ T, Curve (a.budget m) T (Icc l u) ∧
        ∀ x∈ Icc l u,Lives R N m p (T x) ∧ R.Relays N m p (T x) (Q x)

proof_context.conclusion: `Issues` supplies the continuous Wilson curve `initial` on `band a N` and the continuous step `advances` on any interval, with `Lives` (admissible) and `Relays` (the recursion step).

snippet.text: def band (a : Levels G) (m : ℕ) := Icc (a.clock.hatBeta m / 2) (2*a.clock.hatBeta m)

proof_context.conclusion: `band a m` is the interval [hatBeta m / 2, 2 hatBeta m], the coupling band at level m.
